Based on the available evidence, TMGH appears attractively valued: the 2025 EPS of 6.98 LE combined with the market price of 82.50 EGP yields a P/E ratio of about 11.8, which is low relative to many Egyptian listed firms. Net profit for 2025 was 18.202 bn LE (evidence_id TMGH‑TMGH_FY2025_consolidated_en‑p7‑55), and total equity stood at 157.708 bn LE as of 31 Dec 2025 (evidence_id TMGH‑TMGH_FY2025_consolidated_en‑p5‑67), supporting a book‑value‑per‑share of roughly 60 EGP (implied share count from net profit/EPS).
